post.summary: Atomically activate and remove teacher privileges
post.description:
TEACHER activates PREPARED after resource/latest-version checks, or re-enters an owned ACTIVE unarchived context with its existing snapshot. CLOSED cannot reactivate. Already-bound LEARNER may only replay same context/digest. Database session mode downgraded without rotating credential, csrf refreshed. A different learner/context is denied. GET /auth/session resolves lost response.
First activation: owner TEACHER, unarchived student, current plan/profile and matching bundleDigest, atomic ACTIVE+session downgrade+CSRF replacement. Existing ACTIVE: bound LEARNER replay or owner TEACHER re-entry if unarchived, frozen bundle retained. CLOSED denied; other active context 409. Read session/context after lost response.

200.description: Atomically activate and remove teacher privileges

post.summary: Close owned context without deleting history
post.description:
Idempotent; PREPARED or ACTIVE becomes CLOSED. Requires online teacher reauthentication. UI must durably finalize any local in-progress attempt before closing; server cannot inspect another device offline. Closed PREPARED never accepts history. Owning teacher may recover previously ACTIVE history.
Owner TEACHER only, idempotent close PREPARED/ACTIVE/CLOSED. Client must durably finalize local work first; backend cannot verify that browser fact. Serializes with ingestion. No implicit logout or plan replacement.

200.description: Close owned context without deleting history

put.description:
Stable UUID in path and body. Learner restricted to ACTIVE bound context; owning teacher can recover previously activated history. Server replays evidence and commits attempt/items/reward in one transaction. Same canonical body ->200 original receipt, changed body ->409. Max body 1MiB.
Bound LEARNER only for ACTIVE context, or owner TEACHER for any previously activated context including CLOSED/archive history. Expired principal denied. Same canonical body ->200 original receipt (replayed=true), new ->201, changed body ->409. Unique race requires complete rollback then reauthorization/read in new transaction. For an existing attemptId, authorize against its persisted context/student before comparing canonical body, not against the new body contextId. Authorized different structured content is 409 even if new contextId does not exist; another owner is 404.

post.summary: Authenticate the original teacher of the current learner Context
post.description: Current LEARNER and CSRF required. Authenticate credentials and verify the exact ACTIVE Context original owner before any revocation. Invalid credentials return 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS; another valid teacher or mismatched Context returns 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND with learner unchanged. On success atomically revoke only current browser principal, set a fresh TEACHER session cookie and CSRF, return SessionView. No Context or attempt data changes; other browsers are unaffected. Refresh GET /auth/csrf before the next mutation. Retrying after success with the old credential is not idempotent.

post.summary: Resume the same ACTIVE Context with a fresh learner principal
post.description: Original owner TEACHER and CSRF required. ACTIVE Context only; PREPARED returns 403 CONTEXT_NOT_ACTIVATED, CLOSED returns 409 CONTEXT_CLOSED, archived student returns 409 STUDENT_ARCHIVED. Current profile/plan versions do not rebuild or replace the frozen bundle. Atomically revoke only current browser principal and set a fresh LEARNER cookie/CSRF bound to this Context; other browsers and Context/attempt rows are unchanged. Return SessionView and refresh GET /auth/csrf before next mutation. No body; retries with revoked credentials are not idempotent.

Resource.description: Single immutable resource <=5 MiB; bundle total <=30 MiB. SHA-256 is of actual served bytes, not an invented value.

PlanWrite.description: Ordered and distinct activityId/version pairs. Server checks referenced versions.

Plan.description: A newly created student has a virtual empty plan: version 0, planId/revisionId null; GET causes no insert. First PUT with If-Match "0" creates plan and revision. Editing requires If-Match.

LearningBundle.description: Frozen at prepare; first activation checks current profile/plan. Active resume preserves this bundle. optionCount=2 derives stable correct+first authored distractor; ORDER_STEPS always 3 cards.

ActivationReceipt.description: Teacher authorization is removed in the same transaction as activation. Lost response is resolved using GET /auth/session; no offline guessing.

ItemEvidence.description: One item once; visited=false requires empty events and zero duration. Every authored item occurs exactly once, in order. Event seq starts at 1 and is contiguous; only the current item accepts events. Unopened items cannot precede visited ones. Cross-field and chronology checks are server business validation.

AttemptEnvelope.description: Full frozen terminal evidence. All authored items once, in authored order. No client score/reward accepted. Payload <=1 MiB; server validates replay semantics and canonicalizes as defined in synchronization.md.

AttemptReceipt.description: Persisted derived result. replayed may differ on retry; receivedAt and business result stay stable.

AttemptDetail.description: Immutable detail includes original full evidence and frozen context/bundle. occurredAt equals evidence.endedAt. Receipt replayed=false for persisted detail.

IfMatch.description: Quoted current version, including "0" for a new empty plan.
